name: Shinnan'yō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shinnan'yō city emblem in maroon: a ring of concentric arcs with pointed rays enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Flag of the former city of Shinnan'yō in Yamaguchi Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-21.

features.role: Shinnan'yō city emblem — a ring of concentric arcs with pointed rays enclosing a stylised letter V
